GORIDE · PRIVACY POLICY

Your journey. Your information.

Private pre-launch draft · 9 October 2026. Business address and designated grievance contact are awaiting confirmation. No paid booking should be accepted without complete written rental terms.

Rental termsCancellation & refundsPrivacy

This notice explains the information used by GoRide’s website and customer app, and what the owner can access. Last reviewed: 9 October 2026.

1. Information we collect and why

Account information includes your email and protected password credentials, session records and recovery-code hashes. Booking records include name, age, phone, car, location, rental type, dates, price and booking decisions. We use them to operate your account, assess eligibility, handle requests, communicate trip updates and resolve disputes. Sign-in does not verify email or phone ownership.

With your separate consent, we store driving-licence images and optional masked Aadhaar images to help GoRide check rental eligibility and identity. The current system stores images; it does not automatically authenticate Aadhaar, verify a licence, or hide digits for you. Mask Aadhaar before uploading. Never upload an unmasked Aadhaar image. Aadhaar is optional; ask for an alternative identity method and do not provide it merely to create an account.

We also store reviews, private feedback, publication choices and booking-alert preferences. Essential cookies keep you signed in. Security systems and hosting providers may process IP addresses, request logs and device information to deliver and protect the service. The app does not request continuous location or contacts access; camera or photo access is used when you choose a document image.

2. Who can see your information

Your customer account displays your own booking records and documents. The authorised GoRide owner can access customer information and documents to operate rentals and handle support. Customers cannot access the owner Admin Panel or other customers’ private records. Only reviews approved for publication, with your publication consent, display your review name, rating and message to visitors allowed to access the site. Private feedback and identity documents are not published.

Service providers process data as needed for hosting, database and file storage, authentication and app delivery. The service uses OpenAI Sites with Cloudflare infrastructure and Expo for app distribution. External image and font providers may receive connection information when their assets load. If you choose WhatsApp or a messaging provider is enabled, that provider handles communication under its own privacy terms. Phone alerts are not currently active until GoRide connects the service. We do not send document images in booking alerts or sell customer data. Information may be disclosed when legally required or necessary to investigate a specific security or legal issue.

3. Consent and optional choices

Account and booking information is needed to provide the requested service. Document uploads, optional masked Aadhaar, phone alerts and public review publication have separate choices. You may keep in-app updates without agreeing to SMS or WhatsApp alerts. Contact GoRide to withdraw an optional consent; this affects future use, and some lawful booking or dispute records may need to be retained. Withdrawing Aadhaar consent alone does not cancel your access to the service.

4. Storage, retention and security

Documents are stored privately with access checks. Passwords and recovery codes are stored as protected hashes, and session cookies use security controls. No online service can guarantee absolute security. Hosting and service-provider processing may occur outside your city or country; GoRide does not promise India-only storage.

There is currently no automatic booking-record or document deletion schedule. Records remain until manually removed, subject to legal, accounting, safety and dispute needs. You can delete your uploaded document image from your booking page. Contact GoRide for account deletion, access, correction or removal of other records. GoRide will explain any information that must be retained and why. A defined retention schedule must be finalized before public launch.

5. Your requests and complaints

Contact GoRide to request a copy or correction of your information, deletion of your account or data, withdrawal of optional consent, or help with a privacy concern. These requests are handled manually. We may verify your identity using existing booking information, without asking for your password, recovery code or full Aadhaar number. GoRide aims to acknowledge complaints within 48 hours and resolve them within one month, explaining any lawful exception or delay.

6. Adults, updates and contact

Accounts and booking requests are intended for adults aged 18 or older. Self-drive drivers must be at least 21. Do not submit children’s identity documents. Material changes to how information is used will be explained before new uses requiring your consent. The operator’s legal address, designated grievance contact and final retention schedule remain pending during this private pre-launch preview.

Contact GoRide

Email goride@gmail.com, WhatsApp +91 9100852287 or call +91 8610235694. Include your booking reference. Never send a password, recovery code or unmasked Aadhaar.
